items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: A fellow by the name of Eddie Mallory played in that band.

ctx.x: Yes, I think Eddie Barefield told me about that.
Yes, a tremendous band. A fellow by the name of Eddie Mallory played in that band. And I think Doc Cheatham (?) played in that band but I'm not too sure.
Anyhow, on these gigs sometimes -- I don't want to forget this -- Bud Rankin, may I dwell on him for a minute?
